agent: "delivery-orchestrator"
---

Take the linked issue and drive it through the pipeline in AGENTS.md.

1. Confirm the issue meets the Definition of Ready. If not, comment with what is missing and stop.
2. Produce the requirement set and acceptance criteria.
3. Propose the technical approach and wait for architecture approval.
4. Implement the change with tests and documentation.
5. Open a pull request using the template and fill in every gate.
